Re: Meeting at Meta HQ
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Aline Sredni Friday, February 10, 2023 at 5:28:28 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Sabeen Dhanani, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Catherine Eng [opaque block] [contact omitted] Stina Trainor

Dear Sabeen -
A small tweak to the below email containing the logistics for the day and the agenda.
Please do reach out with any questions, changes or concerns.
We look forward to welcoming you to campus!
Thanks,
Aline
From: Aline Sredni < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Friday, February 10, 2023 at 12:51 PM
To: Sabeen Dhanani <[contact omitted]>, Catherine Eng < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Stina
Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Molly Montgomery < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, [contact omitted] <[contact omitted]>, Policy
Visits < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting at Meta HQ
Dear Sabeen -
We are pleased to welcome you, and your delegation to campus on Wednesday, February 15
from 9:15 - 11:30am PT.
Below, please find some logistics information. If you have any further questions or updates on your
timing, please feel free to email me directly here, or call/text me at [opaque block]
Logistics information:
Address: [opaque block]
[opaque block]
Arrival Instructions:
1. We will be meeting in Building 10 at Meta Headquarters.
2. You will have reserved parking spaces.
a. Please let me know how many cars you'll be bringing so we can reserve the
correct amount of spots.

3. Please be sure to have an ID upon arrival.
On-Site POC: Stina Trainor (CCd) will be one of your point of contact for the visit and can be
reached by email or by phone at [opaque block] [contact omitted] [opaque block]
Agenda:
9:15am Arrival
9:15- 9:30am Welcome Remarks
9:30 - 10:00am Quest Demos
10:00 - 10:30am Metaverse Presentation
10:30- 11:00am Digital Literacy + Crisis Response Meeting
11:00- 11:30am Sustainability Strategy Meeting
11:30am Departure
Meta Delegation:
Stina Trainor, Head of Global Policy Engagements
Kylie Holmes, Head of Crisis and Disaster Response
• Lisa Hook, Sustainability Strategy Manager, Stakeholder Engagement
• Molly Montgomery, Director, Public Policy
• Luchen Foster, Director, Global Partners and Programs
USAID Delegation:
Sabeen Dhanani, Deputy Director for Technology
• John O'Bryan, Team Lead, Knowledge and Insights Team
• Molly Dean, Senior Advisor, Digital Finance
Kanchana Sthanumurthy, Digital Technology Program Specialist
Please reach out with any questions, changes or concerns. We look forward to welcoming you to
campus!
Many thanks,

Aline
Aline Treiger Sredni (she/her)
Public Policy Manager

Sabeen and John,
Thanks for your patience. As we craft a schedule for your visit to our Menlo Park office, if you
could please confirm which date works best for your team - the 14' or 15'h? At this point, we'd
ideally have you arrive in the morning with your visit concluding at about 11:30am. Once we nail
down a date, we'll align internally to work out logistics, meetings, and send you a final agenda.
Also copying Aline, who is leading the organization of your visit. Thanks!
Best
Catherine

From: Sabeen Dhanani <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Sunday, January 29, 2023 10:22 PM
To: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Catherine Eng < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Molly Montgomery
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: John O'Bryan <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Meeting at Meta HQ
This Message Is From an External Sender
Hi Brian, Molly, and Catherine,
I am reaching out to share that my colleagues and I from USAID'sTechnology Division will be visiting the San
Francisco Bay area from February 13-15, 2023. We are strategically engaging with private sector partners to
explore new partnership opportunities across the US tech sector as part of USAID's Digital Strategy.
We're quite interested in the work that Meta is doing in connectivity, digital literacy, skills, and workforce
development and investing in Tech ecosystems, and are seeking to identify opportunities that support commercial
objectives while also furthering USAID's development goals, including improving food security, closing the gender
digital divide, increasing climate resilience, and promoting the responsible use of technology.
Can you help us connect to your colleagues on the West Coast who are best positioned to speak to us and could
be available while we are in town?
We look forward to hearing from you.

Sabeen
--
Sabeen V. Dhanani, (she/her)
